issues.description: Bitmap24::save(...) and Bitmap24::set(...) are declared under the private: section in the template header but are public in the solution header. The program (main.cpp) calls bitmap.set(...) and bitmap.save(...). With the template header keeping these methods private, user code will fail to compile (calls from main.cpp are not allowed). This visibility mismatch between TEMPLATE and SOLUTION will block students from building and running the example program.
issues.suggestedFix: Make Bitmap24::set(...) and Bitmap24::save(...) public in the template header (move their declarations above the private: label or remove the private specifier) so the declarations match the solution and allow main.cpp to call them. Alternatively, modify main.cpp to use only the public API present in the template, but the simpler fix is to change the header visibility to public to match the solution.
